title: wiretap: Expand our JSON log support
description:
Dissect Kubernetes Audit logs, Google Cloud Audid logs, and CloudTrail
logs as Falco Events.

notes.body: This is a duplicate of !21409 (I renamed the branch when I shouldn't have).

+The following changes have been made since version 0.9.3:
+
+* Stratoshark and strato can now read plain Kubernetes Audit logs and Google Cloud Audit logs, and CloudTrail logs.
+
 The following changes have been made since version 0.9.2:
 
 * The Windows installers now ship with Qt 6.8.3.
